headline: Approved up to $65,000 for a transit director on a 7-2 vote and $222,040 for rental car facility planning.
summary: A zoning change for 56 Godsoe Road now goes to the Planning Board. A $3,048,959 grant for the Women, Infants, and Children program goes to the Finance Committee. Three special amusement permit renewals were approved, and the November 3 election results were acknowledged.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 26, 2026 council meeting.
Passed an order acknowledging receipt of the official results of the November 3, 2026 elections.
Held first reading and referred the rezoning of 56 Godsoe Road to the November 17, 2026 Planning Board meeting.
Held first reading and referred the $3,048,959 grant acceptance to the November 16, 2026 Finance Committee meeting.
Passed an appropriation of $222,040 in Customer Facility Charge funds for planning the consolidated rental car facility.
Passed an appropriation of up to $65,000 from undesignated fund balance to fund a Director of Transit, by a 7-2 vote.
Approved the special amusement permit renewal for Dysarts, 1110 Broadway, after a public hearing.
Approved the special amusement permit renewal for Timber Kitchen & Bar, 22 Bass Park Boulevard, after a public hearing.
Approved the special amusement permit renewal for Bangor Inn & Suites, 701 Hogan Road, after a public hearing.

Meeting called to order at 7:00 PM

homelessness crisis.

implementation of rent control.

that would run parallel to Stillwater Avenue which would allow her to dispose
of her mother' s estate.

control in the City.
